description: Insider transactions at a company from its Form 4 filings: who (officers, directors, 10% owners), what (open-market buys and sales, option exercises, tax withholding, gifts), shares, price, value, holdings after, and 10b5-1 plan flags, with a buy/sell summary. Default: the last 90 days.

codes.description: Transaction codes to keep, for example ["P", "S"] for open-market purchases and sales. Default: all.

max_filings.description: Most Form 4 filings to read, newest first; default 40.

since.description: Filed on or after; default 90 days ago.

until.description: Filed on or before; default today.

name: insider_trades

outputSchema.description: rows are Form 4 transactions, newest first; summary totals open-market purchases and sales.

title: Insider trades
